directions: For this part, you are allowed 3o minutes to write a short essay on invention. Your essay should include the importance of creation and measures to be taken to encourage creation. You are required to write at least 15O words but no more than 200 words.
sample_essay:
Invention is the driving force behind human progress, enabling us to overcome challenges and improve the quality of life. To begin with, creation is of great importance as it leads to technological advancements. For example, the invention of the Internet has revolutionized the way we communicate, access information, and conduct business. Moreover, it fosters economic growth by creating new industries and job opportunities. Take the smartphone industry, which has not only generated significant revenue but also spurred innovation in related fields.

To encourage creation, several measures can be taken. First, educational institutions should focus on cultivating creative thinking skills among students. By incorporating project-based learning and problem-solving activities into the curriculum, students can develop the ability to think outside the box. In addition, governments and businesses should offer incentives such as grants, tax breaks, and awards to inventors. This will motivate individuals to engage in creative endeavors.

In conclusion, invention is crucial for the development of society. By recognizing its importance and implementing effective measures to encourage it, we can ensure a more innovative and prosperous future.
